text: 古巴电力联盟8月1日通报，当地时间18时7分，该国马坦萨斯省至比那尔德里奥省一带电力系统发生断电。古巴电力联盟在社交媒体上表示，断电是线路跳闸所致。受美国制裁影响，古巴长期以来难以进口燃料及发电厂设备，发电厂设备老旧难更新，全国电力供应紧张。2024年10月以来，因电力设施故障、飓风侵袭等原因，古巴曾多次全国大停电。（央视新闻）
text_en: Cuba's Electric Union reported on Aug. 1 that at 18:07 local time, a power outage hit the system from Matanzas Province to Pinar del Río Province. The union said on social media the outage was caused by a line trip. Due to U.S. sanctions, Cuba has long struggled to import fuel and power plant equipment, leaving aging plants hard to upgrade and the national power supply tight. Since October 2024, Cuba has suffered multiple nationwide blackouts due to equipment failures, hurricanes, and other causes. (CCTV News)
